title: cassia brasiliana var. ferruginea
intro: Cassia brasiliana var. ferruginea, commonly known as Red Cassia, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, characterized by its reddish or purplish flowers and rusty-colored stems. It is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Cassia are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Red Cassia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
